CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Buleleng Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Buleleng Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Buleleng.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Buleleng Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and jdih.bulelengkab.go.id her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
9. Every person is an individual or corporation. 10. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
12. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
15. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their development.
17. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

jdih.bulelengkab.go.id

19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.
20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence, both physically and psychologically.
21. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional Government to carry out the functions and main tasks of integrated services for Women and Children Victims of Violence, including complaint services, Health Rehabilitation, Social Rehabilitation, Repatriation, Social Reintegration, and Legal Aid.
22. Minimum Service Standards hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.

Article 5

Point a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causing death Point b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Point c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Point d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Point e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Point f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
c. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Point g Sufficiently clear.

Point h What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children; b. protect Women and provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; and
c. empower women and children victims of acts of violence.

CHAPTER II

PRINCIPLES AND OBJECTIVES

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence is implemented based on the principles of:
a. respect and fulfillment of the rights of victims of acts of violence; b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of victims of acts of violence; and e. legal certainty.

Article 12

1. Empowerment of victims of acts of violence against women shall be carried out by the Regional Government in the form of:a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and c. capital assistance.
2. Empowerment of victims of acts of violence against children shall be carried out by the Regional Government in the form of providing education, guidance, and counseling.
3. Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be implemented by Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

Article 20

1. The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence. (2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of: a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

CHAPTER VI

COMMUNITY AND BUSINESS PARTICIPATION

Article 18

1. Every person may participate in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by:a. reporting acts of violence against women and/or children; b. providing first aid to victims of Acts of Violence; c. independently socializing the rights of women and children;  and/orad. establishing independent community social institutions.

Article 11

Paragraph (1) Point a What is meant by "complaint service" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.

Point b What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.

Point c What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge jdih.bulelengkab.go.id aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine a way out or efforts to overcome those problems.

Point d What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and coaching to humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.

Point e What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

Point f What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children in a gender-sensitive manner.

Point g What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

Paragraph (2) Point a Sufficiently clear Point b Sufficiently clear Point c What is meant by "Service Center and Safe House" is what is known as a trauma center, while a safe house is known as a shelter.

Point d Sufficiently clear jdih.bulelengkab.go.id Paragraph (3) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (4) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (5) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (6) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (7) Sufficiently clear

Article 6

Every person who hears, sees, or knows of the occurrence of violence as referred to in Article 5is obliged to make efforts to:
a. prevent the continuation of criminal acts;
b. provide protection to victims of acts of violence; c. provide emergency assistance;and /ord. assist in the process of submitting an application for protection order.

In the event that community social institutions implement protection for women and children from acts of violence, they are obliged to coordinate with P2TP2A.

Article 24

1. The Regional Government prepares and compiles an information and reporting system for the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
2. The Information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) is in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protecting here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. In addition, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to receive protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protecting here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. In addition, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to receive protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

CHAPTER II

PRINCIPLES AND OBJECTIVES

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence is implemented based on the principles of:
a. respect and fulfillment of the rights of victims of acts of violence; b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of victims of acts of violence; and e. legal certainty.

Point a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causing death Point b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Point c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Point d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Point e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Point f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

The meaning of protecting here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. In addition, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to receive protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". In addition, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

Article 3

Article 5

Point a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causing death Point b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Point c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Point d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Point e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Point f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protecting here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. In addition, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to receive protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights.Women and child victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination.In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and child victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and child victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation.The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and child victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

Article 5

Point a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causing death Point b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Point c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Point d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Point e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Point f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

PRINCIPLES AND OBJECTIVES

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence is implemented based on the principles of:
a. respect and fulfillment of the rights of victims of acts of violence; b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of victims of acts of violence; and e. legal certainty.

Part One

General

Article 5

Point a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causing death Point b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Point c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Point d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Point e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Point f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

c. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.
